definitions.short: to tap , i.e. beat regularly ; hence (generally) to impel or agitate
definitions.full: H6470. paam [ מָּעַם ] verb thrust, impel (probably originally strike, hit , see derivatives, and Phoenician פעם foot ); — Qal Infinitive construct suffix לְפַעֲמוֺ Judg 13:25 the spirit of ׳י began to impel him. Niph`al be distrurbed, Perfect 1singular נִפְעַמְתִּי Psa 77:5 ; Imperfect 3feminine singular רוּחוֺ וַתִּמָּ֫עֶם Gen 41:8 ; Dan 2:3 ; so Hithpa`el Imperfect 3feminine singular רוּחוֺ וַתִּתְמָּ֫עֶם Dan 2:1 .
